title: Double-slit fringes: 633 nm, slits 0.25 mm apart, screen 2.0 m away
caption: Bright fringes lie where d sin θ = nλ, spaced by x = λD/d = 633 × 10⁻⁹ × 2.0/(2.5 × 10⁻⁴) = 5.1 mm. The intensity I = 4I₀cos²(πdx/λD) varies smoothly between 4I₀ and zero (the single-slit envelope is ignored here). Halving d would double the spacing.
alt: Graph of relative intensity against position on the screen from -15 to 15 millimetres: equally spaced bright fringes 5.1 millimetres apart with dark fringes halfway between.
description: The horizontal axis is position on the screen in millimetres from the centre; the vertical axis is the intensity as a fraction of the maximum, 4I₀.
The curve is cos²(πx/5.1 mm): a bright fringe at the centre and at every 5.1 mm, a dark fringe halfway between them.
The spacing is x = λD/d = 5.1 mm.
